title: All varieties of cotton fabrics, rayon or artificial silk fabrics and woollen fabrics.
text:
13. All varieties of cotton fabrics, rayon or artificial silk fabrics and woollen fabrics.

_Explanation.—The expression “cotton fabrics”, “rayon or artificial silk fabrics” and “woollen fabrics”_

shall have the same meanings as are, respectively assigned to them in the Central Excises and Salt
Act, 1944 (1 of 1944).
